Experience Disasters: Learn to Survive

My first project, built for a Metaverse competition. Users practice surviving earthquakes, floods and fires in a realistic virtual world, with sounds and warning signs. A portal inside the world links to the Saudi Geological Survey website for official information.

المركز الأول: هبه القحطانيمشروع استكشاف الكوارث الطبيعية باستخدام تقنية الواقع الافتراضي
Pitch deck 2026

TruckScope: a digital shield for our roads

Heavy trucks often bypass main roads and enter residential areas, damaging infrastructure and risking public safety, while traditional monitoring is expensive and limited. TruckScope uses satellite imagery and YOLOv8 AI so a user can pick any area and monitor it instantly from the sky.

  • Save lives: prevent accidents in school zones and neighborhoods.
  • Save money: cut road repair costs by detecting illegal truck patterns.
  • Total control: 24/7 automated oversight for a smarter, safer city.
AI agent · Automation

Hebah Agent: an AI agent that builds presentations

I built this agent in n8n and connected it to Telegram. I message the bot with a topic, and it sends back a finished PowerPoint file. In the example below I asked for a presentation about Ithra and got the .pptx in the chat.

  1. Telegram Trigger receives my message.
  2. AI Agent (with an OpenAI chat model) turns the request into slide content.
  3. Code in JavaScript builds the .pptx file.
  4. Send a document returns the file in the chat.

The agent can also run on a schedule, for example every day at 9:00 AM, and send a presentation without me asking.
